name: @astragate-community/middleware-claude-code
description: Astra gateway middleware: present one channel's requests as the official Claude Code CLI's (headers, system prompt, metadata)

summary.en: For channels that serve only the official Claude Code CLI: send that channel's requests with Claude Code's headers and system prompt.
summary.zh: 适用于只接受官方 Claude Code CLI 的渠道：发往该渠道的请求带上 Claude Code 的请求头和系统提示词。
